gloss: to have someone look at; please take a look (humble)

definitions.gloss: to have someone (superior) look at; to show to a respected person
definitions.explanation: A humble expression used when asking or describing the action of a respected person viewing, reading, or watching something. Combines the honorific ご{覧|らん} (looking) with the humble auxiliary いただく (to receive the favor of).

examples.japanese: ぜひご{覧|らん}いただきたいです。
examples.english: I would very much like you to see it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ご{覧|らん}→ご覧：01408_goran⟧⟦いただけます→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Could you please take a look at the materials?

examples.japanese: ⟦{本日|ほんじつ}→本日：09643_honjitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧、⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ご{覧|らん}いただき⟦ありがとうございます→ありがとうございます：09886_arigatougozaimasu⟧。
examples.english: Thank you for taking the time to view the exhibition today despite your busy schedule.

notes:
A polite/humble expression combining ⟦ご{覧|らん}→ご覧：01408_goran⟧ (honorific form of ⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧, to see) with ⟦いただく→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧ (humble auxiliary meaning "to receive the favor of"). Used in business, customer service, and formal settings.

POLITENESS LEVELS FOR "TO SEE/LOOK":
- ⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: plain (neutral)
- ⟦ご{覧|らん}になる→ご覧になる：01311_goranninaru⟧: honorific (⟦{尊敬語|そんけいご}→尊敬語：17106_sonkeigo⟧) — the other person sees
- ご{覧|らん}いただく: humble (⟦{謙譲語|けんじょうご}→謙譲語：15869_kenjougo⟧) — I receive the favor of them seeing
- ⟦{拝見|はいけん}する→拝見する：01823_haikensuru⟧: humble — I humbly look at something

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦ご{覧|らん}→ご覧：01408_goran⟧⟦いただけます→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: could you please look at this?
- ご{覧|らん}いただきたい: I would like you to see this
- ご{覧|らん}いただき⟦ありがとうございます→ありがとうございます：09886_arigatougozaimasu⟧: thank you for viewing
- ⟦ご{覧|らん}→ご覧：01408_goran⟧⟦いただければ→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧⟦{幸|さいわ}い→幸い：02774_saiwai⟧です: I would be grateful if you could look at this

USAGE:
This expression is used when the speaker wants a superior or customer to view something. It is NOT used to describe one's own viewing — for that, use ⟦{拝見|はいけん}する→拝見する：01823_haikensuru⟧.
